proposals.evidence: DEDR2646 explicitly gives Gondi sukkum ‘star’, with other dialectal hukka/ukkum forms. Survey sukku matches the Gondi sukk- branch with its final shape retained; the explicit Telugu-loan label in this article applies to Tamil cukkai, not this Gondi form. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
